strip_msg: strip the email message text by removing block delimiters and extracting the message content between BLOCK_MSG markers
create_PLAIN_template: create an email template string with from, to, and cc fields surrounded by BLOCK_MSG delimiters
define_BLOCK_MSG_constant: define a 28-character BLOCK_MSG constant made of repeated '#' characters for message delimitation
define_BLOCK_OPT_constant: define a 28-character BLOCK_OPT constant made of repeated '%' characters for option delimitation
create_W_OPTS_PREFIX_constant: create a W_OPTS_PREFIX string constant with BLOCK_OPT delimiters for wrapping options
